verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents self-serve programmatic paths for getting data out: the App API is used to 'fetch data' (docs-23/44), the CLI gives 'full access' to workspaces and returns structured JSON (docs-26, docs-48, docs-49), and data-out integrations send data to external platforms like CRMs and analytics tools (docs-29). However, none of the evidence describes an actual audience export, so a founder would have to script one from generic API access. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all contacts with custom attributes and tags; export of engagement history (message and event activity); export of the suppression list; an explicit open file format such as CSV; independent or hands-on confirmation that a full export works.
